Handwoven Water Hyacinth Rectangular Placemats — Natural Texture for Your Table

Elevate your dining experience with these handwoven water hyacinth rectangular placemats. Crafted by skilled artisans, each mat brings natural texture, earthy warmth, and sustainable beauty to your table setting.

Why You’ll Love Them

  • 100% natural water hyacinth — eco-friendly & biodegradable
  • Durable, breathable weave with a natural finish
  • Adds organic texture to any dining or coffee table
  • Lightweight & easy to clean
  • Handcrafted by Indian artisans — each piece unique

Dimensions

Diameter: 12 inches
